role: Mayor of Bordeaux and President of Bordeaux Métropole
description: Elected Mayor of Bordeaux at the first municipal council session on 27 March 2026 after the March 2026 election; also became President of Bordeaux Métropole.

organization: Government of France (Ministry of Economy and Finance), governments of Élisabeth Borne and Gabriel Attal
description: Minister Delegate in charge of Public Accounts, succeeding Gabriel Attal during the July 2023 reshuffle of the Borne government; remained under PM Gabriel Attal until succeeded by Laurent Saint-Martin in September 2024.

role: Member of the National Assembly for Gironde's 1st constituency
description: Elected MP for Gironde's 1st constituency in 2022 (member of the Finance Committee). Seat was held by substitute Alexandra Martin during his ministerial term (2023-2024); re-took the seat, then mandate closed in 2026 ahead of becoming mayor.

role: Municipal and metropolitan councillor of Bordeaux (opposition)
description: Opposition municipal and metropolitan councillor after the 2020 municipal elections, leading an autonomous LREM-aligned opposition group.

organization: Services of the Prime Minister (Édouard Philippe)
description: Appointed by decree as interministerial delegate for public transformation, under the authority of the Prime Minister; resigned in November 2019 to prepare the 2020 Bordeaux municipal campaign.

role: Deputy Secretary General of the Presidency of the Republic
organization: Présidence de la République (Élysée), François Hollande
description: Deputy Secretary General of the Élysée, replacing Boris Vallaud, under President François Hollande.

role: Deputy chief of staff, then chief of staff (Secretary of State for Industry)
organization: Ministry of Economy, Industry and Digital
description: Joined Emmanuel Macron at Bercy as deputy chief of staff (February 2016), then served as chief of staff to Secretary of State for Industry Christophe Sirugue (September 2016).
Deputy general manager of Pôle emploi in charge of strategy, coordination and institutional relations.
Briefly served as deputy director of Human Resources at Orange France.

Joined the General Inspectorate of Finance on leaving the ENA in 2007; served as special rapporteur of the Commission for the Liberation of French Growth (Attali Commission). Placed on leave from the corps in November 2019 for the municipal campaign.

role: Lecturer / co-director of executive master's in public policy management
organization: Université Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne and Sciences Po Paris
description: Taught at University of Paris 1 and at Sciences Po Paris, where he co-directed the executive master's degree in public policy management until 2016.
